title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
statement: Return the length of the longest strictly increasing path in the matrix. Moves are 4-directional.
hints: From each cell, the answer is 1 plus the best answer among strictly greater neighbors.
Memoize by cell. Each cell is solved once because the increasing constraint makes the dependency graph a DAG.
The global answer is the maximum over every starting cell.

approaches.name: Memoized DFS
approaches.explanation: Each cell and each edge is processed once.

editorial: The state is the cell, not the path, because every increasing path that reaches a cell can be extended by the same best continuation. That is why memoization is correct. A cell with no greater neighbor has length 1.
